description: Render a URL in a real headless Chromium browser and capture a PNG screenshot — either the viewport or the full scrolling page (capped at 10,000px tall). Options: viewport width/height, device scale factor (retina), wait condition, and extra delay for late-loading content. Returns a short-lived download URL (valid 1 hour) plus pixel dimensions, byte size and SHA-256; set includeBase64 for the PNG inline (up to 3 MB). Private/internal addresses are blocked. Pure rendering, no AI. For load-time numbers use page_performance_check or pagespeed_insights instead.

delayMs.description: Extra wait after load before capturing, 0-5000 ms (default 0)

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrolling page instead of just the viewport (default false; capped at 10,000px tall)

includeBase64.description: Also return the PNG as base64 in the response (default false; omitted if over 3 MB)

url.description: Page to capture, e.g. https://example.com (https:// is assumed if no scheme)

waitUntil.description: When navigation counts as finished (default load)

name: website_screenshot
title: Website Screenshot
